## Use

Send before a supervision meeting. Limit the main agenda to decisions and feedback that need shared attention.

## Blank template

**Meeting/date:** [ ]
**Purpose:** [What should change by the end?]
**Earlier actions needing attention:** [IDs and current state]

| Time | Decision or feedback needed | Material and evidence | Student recommendation | Desired outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ ] | [ ] | [link] | [ ] | decide / advise / escalate / note |

**Final do-confirm:** decisions; actions with owner/date/evidence; unresolved questions; risks; next review.

## Completed example

| Time | Decision or feedback needed | Material and evidence | Student recommendation | Desired outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 min | Is recruitment ready for privacy review? | recruitment flow v2; access note | consult privacy adviser before ethics draft | decide next gate |

## Scenario test

A student has eight update topics but only one consequential design decision. The agenda moves routine updates to the action register and protects time for the decision.
